m20.text: The Bone Spire is the site of a siege with charnel fields beneath it and a bone-white keep, where an angel appears over the charnel fields at sunrise, bringing a surge of new hope.
Knights charge forward on wings of wind and the necromancer's horde roars in helpless rage, and with a single word the necromancer's legion is unmade.
With each knight that rides out from the keep the queen's soldiers lose courage, and a squire takes up her fallen knight's blade to hold the foe back.
